description: This file defines the SearchProductList class, which extends ProductList to include category facet information for search results in a catalog. It encapsulates a list of ReadableCategory objects representing category facets for product search results.

classes.name: SearchProductList
classes.description: Represents a list of products resulting from a search, including category facets for filtering.

methods.name: getCategoryFacets
methods.description: Returns the list of category facet objects associated with the search results.

methods.name: setCategoryFacets
methods.description: Sets the list of category facet objects for the search results.
